song.lyrics:
[C1] . C D Hallowed be Thy Name . Bm Em Jehovah God You reign . Am D And You will never change O Lord . G Forever You're the same
[V1] . C G Jehovah-Jireh, You supply my every need . C Am Jehovah-Rophe, perfect health You give to me
[V2] . C Jehovah-Shalom, You're the One who gives me peace . C Am Jehovah-Rohi, my Faithful Shepherd leading me
[V3] . C Jehovah-M'kaddesh, You're the One who makes me clean . C Am Jehovah-T'sidkenu, imparting righteousness to me
[V4] . C G Jehovah-Nissi, Lord You reign in victory . C Am Jehovah-Shammah, You are always there for me
song.title: Hallowed Be Thy Name
